If OpenClaw is an employee, Paperclip is the company.

items.title: Show HN: Squint – Drag a box on your screen and ask AI about it
items.contentSnippet:
It improves the usual workflow: take a screenshot, switch to a chat tab, upload it, switch back.
- Built with Rust and Tauri v2, including a built-in native screenshot solution for maximum performance and stability.
- Answers come from OpenAI models. Fast, the default, usually starts answering within 1–2 seconds; Best is slightly slower, but provides a much higher quality response.

items.title: Show HN: EthosLM - Turn a sentence into a Minecraft city
items.contentSnippet:
I built EthosLM to turn a description of a place into something you can walk around in Minecraft.
The demo starts with “Build me Ba Sing Se.” It produces a city with districts, roads, walls and furnished interiors. Here's the one-minute video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lgixrYLWfhc
It works by separating planning from construction. The model chooses the layout and style. A deterministic library generates the buildings, places the blocks and checks the result.

items.title: Show HN: Jobless Joke Language (JJL), a Brainf***-inspired esoteric language
items.contentSnippet:
JJL is a small esoteric programming language inspired by Brainfuck, featuring absolute memory navigation, multiplier arithmetic, non-destructive inspection, and inline conditionals. Originally conceived as a small programming experiment, it turned into a surprisingly entertaining exercise in language design and interpreter implementation.

items.title: Show HN: swe-mux – A terminal multiplexer for coding agents optimized for mobile
items.contentSnippet: I run a lot of coding agents at once, mostly Claude Code, Codex and pi, across several projects. I got tired of having so many windows open, of agents leaving hung processes behind, of tracking which one needed input, and of having to remote into my desktop or SSH into a single shell to manage them from my phone. Even then, a terminal on a phone couldn't show me the frontend or output I needed to verify the work. I tried Orca and herdr. Both were better than my setup, but neither had a real WYSI
